author: Latham, 1790
summary: 산림과 트인 개활지에 사는 새로, 뻐꾸기류 가운데 몸집이 작은 편이다. 대부분 휘파람새 둥지에 알을 맡기고, 굴뚝새와 산솔새 둥지에도 탁란한다. 국내에서는 경기도, 평안남도, 평안북도, 제주도 등에 살고, 국외에서는 극동 러시아, 중국, 일본, 동남아시아에 분포한다.

points.en: bold, well-defined black markings on the belly

sexes.text: 암수 생김새가 거의 같으나, 암컷 가운데에는 온몸이 적갈색 바탕에 검은 가로줄이 있는 적색형도 있다.

young: 어린새는 윗면이 검은 갈색~회색이고 깃 가장자리가 희며, 멱과 가슴까지 거무스름하다. 적갈색 바탕에 검은 가로줄이 있는 적색형 어린새도 있다.

similar.how: 생김새가 비슷하나 배의 검은 줄무늬가 더 굵고 뚜렷하다.

art.subject: Lesser Cuckoo (Cuculus poliocephalus), adult male as seen in Korean forests and forest edges from May to August: head, neck, throat and upper breast grey; upperparts dark slate-grey; wings dark grey-brown; lower breast and belly white, often with a faint buff tinge, crossed by bold, broad, widely spaced black bars; vent and undertail coverts buffish with few or no bars; tail long, dark grey-black, tipped white. Bill dark with a yellow base; dark brown iris with a yellow eye-ring; legs yellow.
art.pose: perched on a branch at a forest edge
art.scene: Korean forest edge opening onto open country; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched: small slim cuckoo, grey head and upper breast, dark slate-grey upperparts, white belly with bold, broad, widely spaced black bars, dark eye with a yellow eye-ring, yellow legs

adult, underparts close-up from the front: grey upper breast sharply cut off from the white lower breast and belly, which carry bold black bars thicker and more widely spaced than in Common Cuckoo, buffish vent with few bars
art.build: Small, slim cuckoo, 28cm, about the length of a Brown-eared Bulbul and clearly smaller and slighter than a Common Cuckoo; long pointed wings and a long, graduated tail; perches horizontally with drooped wings. Bill short and slightly decurved. Legs short, yellow, with two toes forward and two back. The long tail extends well beyond the wingtips. Flight fast and direct, like a small falcon.
avoid: Do not paint a yellow or red iris; Lesser Cuckoo has a dark eye with a yellow eye-ring (Common Cuckoo's eye is yellow).
Do not paint fine, dense, narrow barring like a Common Cuckoo's; the bars are bold and widely spaced.
Do not make it large or bulky; it is clearly smaller than a Common Cuckoo.
Do not paint a broad black subterminal tail band (Indian Cuckoo).
